BEFORE YOUR FIRST PRINT

A small test.
A better build.

These are digital prototypes, not physically tested products. Inspect the sliced preview, test the snap fit, and verify the installation load before filling. The downloads include the actual dimensions, part-specific support notes, and plate assignments.

NESTFORGEMade by Stephen Shaffer LinkedIn ↗R7 · October 2026
NESTFORGE · MAKER NOTES

From plate to branch.

Each feeder has a CAD download and a print pack with individual STL parts and populated, color-assigned 3MF plates sized for the Bambu Lab X1 Carbon. Dragon Guard combines editable structural STEP with a credited community sculpt mesh; its STL and 3MF contain the complete printable shape.

1. Open & inspect

Open a plate as a project in Bambu Studio. Match the filament slots to the colors shown on that plate. Each plate uses no more than four colors. Some builds use more colors overall; reload the AMS between those plates. These files are unsliced; no machine G-code is supplied. Confirm the X1 Carbon, 0.4 mm nozzle, your exact filament profile, and textured PEI plate.

Backyard camera feeders

Each new feeder has its own seed arrangement, feeding surface and camera integration. The catalog spans a roofed hopper, an octagonal lantern, a leaf-shaped wall pocket, an oval pod, open platforms and other distinct structures. Each design is intended for one specified camera; camera mounts are not interchangeable. Wyze Battery Cam Pro builds require the official close-up lens. Birdfy builds leave space above the camera for its antenna. Hardware previews are approximate; physical fit, focus, drainage and installation strength still need testing. Shopping links are dated US price snapshots.

2. Print a fit check

Start with PETG for fit trials. Use 0.20 mm layers, four walls, and at least five top/bottom layers as a starting point. Snap hooks and release windows use designed clearance; tune the fit for your printer and material. Read each part’s support notes before slicing. Remove every support and string from feeding openings.

3. Choose the outdoor material

ASA is a candidate for prolonged outdoor exposure when printed with appropriate ventilation. PETG is an easier prototype option. Avoid PLA for a hot, sun-exposed installation. Use one compatible material family for all AMS colors.

4. Assemble & install

Follow the individual assembly and mounting instructions. Fully seat each snap shoulder and verify its release remains accessible. Hanging feeders need UV-resistant cord and suitable tree-friendly hardware; wall and post models need the listed mounting hardware. The timber supports in the preview illustrate the installation and are not printed parts. Test the empty assembly near the ground, then test the intended seed and camera load before installation. Bottle Bough also needs a measured recycled bottle; its neck is not a universal fit.

5. Keep it clean

Add only a shallow daily seed portion to the open trays. Remove wet seed and clean the feeder regularly; printed layer grooves need attention. Keep drain holes open. Inspect for cracks, loose cords, and sharp edges. Fine printed mesh is for whole seed, not dust or tiny millet.

A living preview

Select a feeder to watch a songbird inspect it, depart, and reveal the exploded assembly. The feeder rotates as the bird visits, then unfolds, reassembles, and repeats. Moving labels follow each part. Pause for a closer look; selecting a part pauses the sequence. Reduced-motion settings show a static exploded view. Scroll below the viewer for actual plate layouts and planning time estimates. Nature audio stays off until you choose Sound; use the control to mute or adjust the volume.

What changed from the concept art?

Clear panels became printed openings or lattice. Drainage is part of the base. Roofs, shells and trays snap together. Contrasting details are welded color regions within each printed part. Masonry, shingles, veins, vents and other larger textures are actual CAD geometry. Purchased cameras, solar panels, mounting hardware and any reused bottle are not included in print downloads.

All six castle concepts now have separate designs, including the chapel and dragon citadel. Spiral Football, Duck Spa, Mimic Chest, Disco Donut, Drone Nest, Sentry Cam and Geodesic Fusion have been added. The two starship concepts retain separate rocket and capsule models.
